description: This file defines the 'TaskListItemComponent', an Angular component responsible for rendering a single task item with controls for toggling completion status, editing, and deleting the task. It includes inputs, outputs, and event handling methods related to task management.

classes.name: TaskListItemComponent
classes.description: Angular component that displays a task with controls for toggle, edit, and delete actions.

methods.name: onToggleChange
methods.description: Handles toggle change events, emits the toggled event with task id and new completion status.

methods.name: onEdit
methods.description: Emits the edit event with the current task object to trigger editing.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Emits the remove event with task id to delete the task.

ctags.name: checked
ctags.pattern: /^    const checked = !!(inputEl && 'checked' in inputEl ? inputEl.checked : false);$/

ctags.name: inputEl
ctags.pattern: /^    const inputEl = ev && typeof ev === 'object' && 'target' in (ev as any) ? (ev as any).target/
